verses.restored: O sing to YHWH a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

familiar.text: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

modern.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.

original.text: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

familiar.text: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

modern.text: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.

original.text: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

familiar.text: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

modern.text: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

original.text: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: Make a joyful noise to YHWH, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

familiar.text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

modern.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!

original.text: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ

verses.restored: Sing to YHWH with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

familiar.text: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

modern.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.

original.text: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה

familiar.text: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

modern.text: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
